Online-Reservierungen können längstens bis 18.00 Uhr am Vortag des Ankunftsdatums getätigt werden. Für spätere Reservierungen, rufen Sie uns direkt in der Hütte an. Wir führen keine Warteliste!

Bei uns ist keine Kartenzahlung möglich, alle Kosten (Konsumation und Übernachtung) müssen direkt vor Ort in bar beglichen werden.

Unsere Erlanger Hütte steht im vorderen Ötztal auf 2550 Metern Höhe, kurz unterhalb des romantisch gelegenen Wettersees. Ihr ursprünglicher Charme besticht Wanderer und Spaziergänger und lädt zum Verweilen ein. In unmittelbarer Umgebung befinden sich der knapp 3000 Meter hohe Wildgrat mit gut ausgeschildertem Wandersteig sowie weitere Nebengipfel, die fortgeschrittene Wanderer in weglosem, blockigem Gelände gut erreichen. Der herrliche Wettersee, sein kristallklares Wasser und die sich darin spiegelnde Bergwelt strahlen eine große Ruhe aus und machen es leicht, die Seele baumeln zu lassen.

Ausstattung:

  • Hochalpine Hütte auf 2550m in den Ötztaler Alpen (DAV-Kategorie 1)
  • Bewirtschaftet von Ende Juni bis Mitte September
  • 48 Schlafplätze in Zweibettzimmern, Mehrbettzimmern, Matratzenlager
  • Gemütliche Gaststube mit etwa 50 Sitzplätzen
  • Sonnenterrasse
  • Nebengebäude als Seminarraum nutzbar
  • ganzjährig zugänglicher Winterraum
  • Regionale, frische Küche: Mitglied bei „So schmecken die Berge“
  • Nachhaltige Energie und Abwasser: Auszeichnung mit dem Tiroler Umweltsiegel „Wirtschaften mit der Natur“ (seit 1996) und dem Umwelt-Gütesiegel der Alpenvereine (seit 2000)
  • Lage: Nördlicher Geigenkamm zwischen dem Vorderen Ötztal und dem Pitztal in Nachbarschaft zum imposanten Wildgrat mit 2971 Metern, zu dem ein gut ausgeschildeter Bergweg führt.
  • Anspruch: Fortgeschrittene Wanderer finden in direkter Umgebung weitere Nebengipfel, die über wegloses blockiges Gelände zu erreichen sind.
  • Wege: In unserem dortigen Arbeitsgebiet halten wir fast 70 km Bergwege instand

Welcome to the Habsburghaus!

Our team delights you with traditional Austrian cuisine, vegan dishes, and rooms that shine with their breathtaking views.

What does that mean for you?

Authentic, regional food from local family businesses, heartfelt hospitality, and an atmosphere that invites you to pause – right in the impressive nature of the Rax mountains. Whether as a rest stop during a hike or for an unforgettable mountain hut overnight stay: the Habsburghaus should be remembered as a place where you don’t just see the mountains – you feel them.

Our Hermann-von-Barth Hut (HvB Hut for short) is a Category I Alpine Club hut. It is located at an altitude of 2,131 meters above sea level, making it the highest refuge hut in the Allgäu Alps. Located above the village of Elbigenalp, centrally on the main high-altitude trail of the Hornbach chain between the Kemptner Hut and Kaufbeurer Haus, it is a worthwhile destination for day trips. The immediate surroundings offer plenty of summit destinations and climbing routes of all levels of difficulty. The sun terrace offers a panoramic view of various 3,000-meter peaks. In addition to a cozy dining room, the child-friendly hut offers approx. 70 beds, a winter and group room, a drying room, and plenty of Tyrolean hospitality.

Three points we'd like to draw your attention to:

  1. Please don't forget your sleeping bag liner; it's mandatory.
  2. Please take your trash back down to the valley with you.
  3. We don't have showers, but we do have nice washing facilities and plenty of warmth and hospitality.

🏔 SIEGERLANDHÜTTE – 2,710 m

Our hut was built in 1928/1929 at the very end of the Windach Valley and was officially inaugurated in 1930. Situated at 2,710 metres above sea level, right at the foot of the highest peaks of the Stubai Alps, it offers breathtaking views across the valley and the surrounding 3,000-metre summits. Over the decades, the Siegerlandhütte has been renovated and structurally expanded several times. Today, as a Category 1 mountain hut with a total of 58 beds, it provides a stay that is both cosy and comfortable.

📅 SEASON

Late June to early September

🥾 APPROACH

• From Sölden via Gasthaus Fiegl: approx. 5 hours

• You can take the hiking bus to Gasthaus Fiegl (information: https://www.oetztaler.at/linienverkehr/fahrplaene-sommer/54b-wanderbus-windach/)

🍽 CATERING

Our kitchen offers something for everyone: classic hut dishes such as dumplings in many variations, hearty Tyrolean snacks, as well as fresh or homemade cakes. In the evening, we treat our guests to a changing four-course menu each day. You will find matching drinks on our extensive bar menu. In the morning, we serve a breakfast buffet with hot drinks. Upon request, we are happy to prepare a packed lunch for your onward hike. We place great value on regional, high-quality ingredients and therefore work with local partners. More information about our suppliers can be found on our website.

ℹ️ INFORMATION

• Online reservations are only possible the day before arrival

• The deposit is €30 per person per night

• For last-minute requests, please contact us directly

• Contact: https://linktr.ee/siegerlandhuette

We look forward to welcoming you!

Luis, Peter & hut dog Spax 🏔️

466.en:
🏔 Sillianer Hut – 2,447 m

The Sillianer Hut is located at 2,447 m on the main ridge of the Carnic Alps, directly on the border between East Tyrol and South Tyrol. It is the westernmost hut on the Karnischer Höhenweg and offers a unique panoramic view of the Sexten Dolomites, the Lienz Dolomites and the Puster Valley.

The hut is an ideal starting point for mountain hikes, summit tours and stages of the Karnischer Höhenweg. It is particularly popular as a starting or finishing point for multi-day tours along the Austrian–Italian border. With a view of the Three Peaks, it delights not only hikers but also mountain bikers – a perfect place for anyone who wants to combine nature and activity.

🥾 Access

From Sillian via the Leckfeldalm area: approx. 3 hours

With the Thurntaler cable car to the top station, then along the Karnischer Höhenweg: approx. 2 hours

Ascent also possible from Kartitsch or Innervillgraten.

🏡 Facilities

Comfortable rooms and dormitories

Modern common room with stunning scenery

Drying room, showers

🍽 Catering

Our kitchen offers regional Tyrolean specialities, homemade cakes and vegetarian dishes.

Half board is available; breakfast from 6:30 a.m., hot meals until 7:00 p.m.
